---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m6p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Elevator, none, MaxClock, MaxTerm

ASSUME MaxClock \in Nat /\ MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm > 0

VARIABLES leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, inCS, term
vars == <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, inCS, term>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseHolder \in Elevator \cup {none}
    /\ leaseExp \in 0..(MaxClock + MaxTerm)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ inCS \in [Elevator -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ leaseHolder = none
    /\ leaseExp = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ inCS = [e \in Elevator |-> FALSE]
    /\ term = 1

AcquireLease(e) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = none \/ clock >= leaseExp
    /\ \A x \in Elevator : ~inCS[x]
    /\ leaseHolder' = e
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inCS, term>>

Enter(e) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = e
    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ ~inCS[e]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![e] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, term>>

Exit(e) ==
    /\ inCS[e]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![e] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, term>>

Renew(e) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = e
    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, clock, inCS, term>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, inCS, term>>

ReleaseLease(e) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = e
    /\ ~inCS[e]
    /\ leaseHolder' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseExp, clock, inCS, term>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ \E t \in 1..MaxTerm : t # term /\ term' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Elevator : AcquireLease(e)
    \/ \E e \in Elevator : Enter(e)
    \/ \E e \in Elevator : Exit(e)
    \/ \E e \in Elevator : Renew(e)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E e \in Elevator : ReleaseLease(e)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutEx ==
    \A e1 \in Elevator, e2 \in Elevator : (inCS[e1] /\ inCS[e2]) => e1 = e2
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Elevator = {E1, E2}
    none = none
    MaxClock = 3
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutEx
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper guards a single express maintenance shaft as a critical resource, using lease-based ownership with expiry. An elevator acquires the shaft's lease only when the lease is free or has expired and, crucially, only while no elevator currently occupies the shaft; the lease is stamped with an expiry equal to the current clock plus the current lease term. The lease holder may enter the shaft while its lease is still unexpired, and later exits. The holder may renew its lease to push the expiry forward, and may release the lease when it is not inside the shaft. A shared clock ticks forward. The lease term length is reconfigured at runtime, changing how long newly granted or renewed leases last. SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one elevator is ever inside the express maintenance shaft at the same time.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Ctrl, Breaker, none, MaxClock, TERM

ASSUME MaxClock \in Nat /\ TERM \in Nat /\ TERM > 0

VARIABLES clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, tripMsgs, tripped
vars == <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, tripMsgs, tripped>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ leaseHolder \in Ctrl \cup {none}
    /\ leaseExp \in 0..(MaxClock + TERM)
    /\ tripMsgs \subseteq Breaker
    /\ tripped \subseteq Breaker

    /\ leaseHolder = none
    /\ leaseExp = 0
    /\ tripMsgs = {}
    /\ tripped = {}

    /\ leaseHolder' = c
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + TERM
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, tripMsgs, tripped>>

Renew(c) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = c
    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + TERM
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, tripMsgs, tripped>>

Issue(b) ==
    /\ leaseHolder # none
    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ b \notin tripped
    /\ b \notin tripMsgs
    /\ tripMsgs' = tripMsgs \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, tripped>>

Apply(b) ==
    /\ b \in tripMsgs
    /\ tripped' = tripped \cup {b}
    /\ tripMsgs' = tripMsgs \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, tripMsgs, tripped>>

ReleaseLease(c) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = c
    /\ leaseHolder' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseExp, tripMsgs, tripped>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : AcquireLease(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Renew(c)
    \/ \E b \in Breaker : Issue(b)
    \/ \E b \in Breaker : Apply(b)

    Ctrl = {c1, c2}
    Breaker = {bk1, bk2}
    none = none
    MaxClock = 3
    TERM = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOnceTrip
nl: A power-grid load shedder trips breakers to shed load, and tripping a breaker is an irreversible action. The authority to issue trip commands is held under a lease with an expiry measured against a shared clock: a controller acquires the lease when it is free or expired, may renew it while it is still valid, and may release it. Only a controller holding a valid, unexpired lease may issue a trip command for a breaker that is neither already tripped nor already the target of a pending command. Trip commands travel over a control bus where messages can be reordered, so any pending command may be applied in any order, permanently tripping its breaker. The shared clock ticks forward. SAFETY PROPERTY: no pending trip command ever targets a breaker that has already been tripped, so the irreversible tripping of any breaker happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m9p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slot, Request, free, noSlot, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES slotOwner, reqSlot, epoch, crashed
vars == <<slotOwner, reqSlot, epoch, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ slotOwner \in [Slot -> Request \cup {free}]
    /\ reqSlot \in [Request -> Slot \cup {noSlot}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ crashed \subseteq Request

Init ==
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slot |-> free]
    /\ reqSlot = [r \in Request |-> noSlot]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Allocate(r, s) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ slotOwner[s] = free
    /\ reqSlot[r] = noSlot
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ reqSlot' = [reqSlot EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ reqSlot[r] # noSlot
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![reqSlot[r]] = free]
    /\ reqSlot' = [reqSlot EXCEPT ![r] = noSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ slotOwner' = [s \in Slot |-> free]
    /\ reqSlot' = [r \in Request |-> noSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, reqSlot, epoch>>

Recover(r) ==
    /\ r \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, reqSlot, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Request, s \in Slot : Allocate(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Request : Release(r)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E r \in Request : Crash(r)
    \/ \E r \in Request : Recover(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A r \in Request : reqSlot[r] # noSlot => slotOwner[reqSlot[r]] = r
=============================================================================

    Slot = {sl1, sl2}
    Request = {rq1, rq2}
    free = free
    noSlot = noSlot
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl: A vending machine network assigns product slots to dispense requests, and the network is periodically reconfigured through an epoch-numbered scheme that bumps a shared epoch. A live request allocates a free slot when it currently holds none, recording the request against the slot and the slot against the request. A request may release the slot it holds, freeing it. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch and bulk-clears every allocation, returning all slots to free. Any request's issuer may crash silently: once crashed it stops allocating new slots, though a supervisor may still release a slot left dangling by a crashed issuer, and the issuer may later recover. SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a request holds a product slot, that slot's owner names exactly that request, so the same slot is never double-allocated to two requests.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m8p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Batch, Idx, Worker, none, noBatch, CAP

ASSUME CAP \in Nat

Entry == Batch \X Idx
BatchOf(e) == e[1]

VARIABLES batchLock, entryOwner, posted, held, admin
vars == <<batchLock, entryOwner, posted, held, admin>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ batchLock \in [Batch -> Worker \cup {none}]
    /\ entryOwner \in [Entry -> Worker \cup {none}]
    /\ posted \subseteq Entry
    /\ held \in [Worker -> Batch \cup {noBatch}]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ batchLock = [b \in Batch |-> none]
    /\ entryOwner = [e \in Entry |-> none]
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ held = [w \in Worker |-> noBatch]
    /\ admin = FALSE

LockBatch(w, b) ==
    /\ batchLock[b] = none
    /\ held[w] = noBatch
    /\ batchLock' = [batchLock EXCEPT ![b] = w]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entryOwner, posted, admin>>

LockEntry(w, e) ==
    /\ held[w] = BatchOf(e)
    /\ entryOwner[e] = none
    /\ entryOwner' = [entryOwner EXCEPT ![e] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, posted, held, admin>>

Post(w, e) ==
    /\ entryOwner[e] = w
    /\ e \notin posted
    /\ Cardinality(posted) < CAP
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, entryOwner, held, admin>>

AdminPost(e) ==
    /\ admin
    /\ e \notin posted
    /\ Cardinality(posted) < CAP
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, entryOwner, held, admin>>

Unpost(e) ==
    /\ e \in posted
    /\ posted' = posted \ {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, entryOwner, held, admin>>

UnlockEntry(w, e) ==
    /\ entryOwner[e] = w
    /\ entryOwner' = [entryOwner EXCEPT ![e] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, posted, held, admin>>

UnlockBatch(w) ==
    /\ held[w] # noBatch
    /\ \A e \in Entry : BatchOf(e) = held[w] => entryOwner[e] # w
    /\ batchLock' = [batchLock EXCEPT ![held[w]] = none]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = noBatch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entryOwner, posted, admin>>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, entryOwner, posted, held>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Worker, b \in Batch : LockBatch(w, b)
    \/ \E w \in Worker, e \in Entry : LockEntry(w, e)
    \/ \E w \in Worker, e \in Entry : Post(w, e)
    \/ \E e \in Entry : AdminPost(e)
    \/ \E e \in Entry : Unpost(e)
    \/ \E w \in Worker, e \in Entry : UnlockEntry(w, e)
    \/ \E w \in Worker : UnlockBatch(w)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == Cardinality(posted) =< CAP
=============================================================================
nl: A bank's interbank settlement batch posts settlement entries into a bounded clearing window. Locking is hierarchical: each entry belongs to a batch, and a worker must first take the coarse lock on the entry's batch before it may take the fine lock on the entry. A worker locks a free batch, then, holding that batch, locks a free entry within it. Holding an entry's fine lock, the worker posts the entry into the clearing window as long as the window is below its fixed capacity, or unposts an entry to free a slot. A worker releases an entry's fine lock, and releases a batch's coarse lock once it holds no entry in that batch. A privileged admin override may be toggled; while on, the administrator may post an entry directly without holding any lock, but it still respects the window's capacity. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of entries posted in the clearing window never exceeds its fixed capacity.

    /\ leaseExp' = clock + TERM
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, record, acked>>

    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ e \notin record
    /\ record' = record \cup {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, acked>>

    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ e \in record
    /\ e \notin acked

    /\ clock < leaseExp
    /\ e \in record
    /\ e \notin acked
    /\ record' = record \ {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, acked>>

    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, record, acked>>

    /\ leaseHolder = i
    /\ leaseHolder' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseExp, record, acked>>

Next ==

    \/ \E i \in Instance : Renew(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instance, e \in Entry : Write(i, e)
    \/ \E i \in Instance, e \in Entry : Ack(i, e)
    \/ \E i \in Instance, e \in Entry : Compact(i, e)

    Entry = {en1, en2, en3}
    none = none
    MaxClock = 3
    TERM = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl: A container-ship crane yard is run by two independent control instances that share one common manifest record, and exclusive write access is granted by lease-based ownership with expiry against a shared clock. An instance acquires the write lease when it is free or expired, stamping an expiry of the current clock plus the lease term, and may renew it while it is still valid or release it. Only the instance holding a valid, unexpired lease may write a new entry into the shared manifest, acknowledge an entry already in the manifest as durably committed, or compact the manifest by removing an entry that is present but not yet acknowledged; it must never compact an acknowledged entry. The shared clock ticks forward, and a lease that is not renewed in time expires, letting the other instance take over. SAFETY PROPERTY: every entry that has been acknowledged as durably committed is always still present in the shared manifest record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost across a lease handover.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m4p2t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N, TOTAL, CAP

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N > 1 /\ TOTAL \in Nat /\ CAP \in Nat

Station == 0..(N - 1)
Move == {m \in Station \X Station : m[1] # m[2]}
SrcOf(m) == m[1]
DstOf(m) == m[2]

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES station, queue, transit, admin
vars == <<station, queue, transit, admin>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ station \in [Station -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ queue \in Seq(Move)
    /\ transit \in [Move -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ station = [s \in Station |-> IF s = 0 THEN TOTAL ELSE 0]
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ transit = [m \in Move |-> 0]
    /\ admin = FALSE

Enqueue(m) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < CAP
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, m)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<station, transit, admin>>

Pick ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ station[SrcOf(Head(queue))] >= 1
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![SrcOf(Head(queue))] = station[SrcOf(Head(queue))] - 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = transit[Head(queue)] + 1]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED admin

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ transit[m] > 0
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![DstOf(m)] = station[DstOf(m)] + 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![m] = transit[m] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, admin>>

AdminMove(src, dst) ==
    /\ admin
    /\ src # dst
    /\ station[src] >= 1
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![src] = station[src] - 1, ![dst] = station[dst] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, transit, admin>>

CancelHead ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ station[SrcOf(Head(queue))] = 0
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<station, transit, admin>>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED <<station, queue, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Move : Enqueue(m)
    \/ Pick
    \/ \E m \in Move : Deliver(m)
    \/ \E src \in Station, dst \in Station : AdminMove(src, dst)
    \/ CancelHead
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == SumF(station, Station) + SumF(transit, Move) = TOTAL
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    N = 2
    TOTAL = 2
    CAP = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl: An airport baggage router moves bags between stations by scheduling moves through a bounded work queue. A move naming a source and destination station is enqueued only while the queue is below its capacity, providing backpressure; enqueueing moves no bag. Picking the head move, when its source station has a bag, takes one bag from the source into transit for that move; delivering an in-transit bag drops it at the destination station. A head move whose source is empty may be cancelled and dropped, moving no bag. A privileged admin override may be toggled on and off; while on, an administrator may move one bag directly from any non-empty station to another, bypassing the queue in a single atomic step. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of bags, summed over all stations plus all in-transit moves, is always exactly the fixed bag count, so no bag is ever created or destroyed.

    /\ queue \in Seq(Item)
    /\ beacon \in BOOLEAN

    /\ pEpoch = [c \in Ctrl |-> 0]
    /\ authorized = Ctrl
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ beacon = FALSE

Sync(c) ==
    /\ pEpoch[c] # epoch
    /\ pEpoch' = [pEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, authorized, queue, beacon>>

Enqueue(c) ==
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ pEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ Len(queue) < CAP
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, [sub |-> c, ep |-> pEpoch[c]])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, authorized, beacon>>

Process ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, authorized, beacon>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ queue' = <<>>
    /\ \E S \in (SUBSET Ctrl) \ {{}} : authorized' = S
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pEpoch, beacon>>

    /\ beacon' = ~beacon
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, authorized, queue>>

    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Enqueue(c)
    \/ Process
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Beacon

    MaxEpoch = 1
    CAP = 2

NEXT Next

nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper accepts dispatch requests from a set of floor controllers into a bounded work queue. The bank carries a configuration epoch that is bumped on reconfiguration, and each controller caches the epoch it has observed; controllers are slow but never fail, so a lagging controller may hold a stale epoch for a while but always eventually syncs up to the current epoch. A controller may enqueue a request only when it is currently authorized, is running the current epoch, and the queue is below its capacity; the queued item is stamped with the controller's observed epoch, providing backpressure. The dispatcher processes the head request. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, clears the queue of any now-stale requests, and chooses a fresh non-empty set of authorized controllers. A liveness beacon toggles to show the slow controllers are still responsive. SAFETY PROPERTY: every request in the work queue was submitted by a currently-authorized controller stamped with the current epoch, so no unauthorized or stale controller ever has a request in the queue.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m0p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Robot, Authorized, none, noSnap, MaxVer

ASSUME Authorized \subseteq Robot /\ MaxVer \in Nat

VARIABLES ver, writer, writeVer, snap, beacon
vars == <<ver, writer, writeVer, snap, beacon>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ writer \in Robot \cup {none}
    /\ writeVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Robot -> (0..MaxVer) \cup {noSnap}]
    /\ beacon \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ writer = none
    /\ writeVer = 0
    /\ snap = [r \in Robot |-> noSnap]
    /\ beacon = FALSE

Read(r) ==
    /\ snap[r] = noSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, writer, writeVer, beacon>>

Commit(r) ==
    /\ r \in Authorized
    /\ snap[r] # noSnap
    /\ snap[r] = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ writer' = r
    /\ writeVer' = snap[r]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = noSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED beacon

Retry(r) ==
    /\ snap[r] # noSnap
    /\ snap[r] # ver
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = noSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, writer, writeVer, beacon>>

Beacon ==
    /\ beacon' = ~beacon
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, writer, writeVer, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robot : Read(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : Commit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : Retry(r)
    \/ Beacon

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleUnauth ==
    writer # none => (writer \in Authorized /\ writeVer = ver - 1)
=============================================================================

nl: A warehouse robot fleet updates a shared inventory record using optimistic locking with retry. The record carries a version number. A robot reads the current version into a private snapshot, then attempts to commit an update: the commit succeeds only if the robot is an authorized writer and its snapshot still equals the live version, in which case the version is bumped and the record notes this robot as the last writer together with the version its update was based on. If another robot committed first, the slow robot's snapshot is stale, so it discards the snapshot and retries by reading again; robots are slow but never fail, so a lagging robot always eventually catches up. Only authorized robots may ever commit. A liveness beacon toggles to show the slow robots are still responsive. SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the record names a last writer, that writer is authorized and its committed update was based on the immediately preceding version, so no unauthorized or stale robot's write ever takes effect.

    /\ depot' = depot - 1
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![d] = holds[d] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, votes, depot>>

    \/ \E m \in Move : Execute(m)
    \/ \E d \in Drone : Deposit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drone : Withdraw(d)
    \/ SetCap

nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm distributes coverage units among its drones, and every reassignment is authorised by quorum voting among controllers. Voters cast votes for a directed move of one coverage unit from one drone to another; once a quorum has approved, the move executes atomically, decrementing the source drone and incrementing the destination, provided the destination is below its current capacity, and then clears the move's votes. A drone may deposit one of its units into a shared reserve depot, and may withdraw a unit from the depot as long as it stays within its current capacity. Each drone's receiving capacity changes at runtime as thermal limits shift. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of coverage units, summed over all drones plus the shared depot, is always exactly the fixed unit total, so no coverage unit is ever created or destroyed.
